name: apple-pages-mcp
description: Read, create and export Apple Pages documents through the Pages app
long_description:
A local MCP server written in Swift that gives Claude access to the Pages app on this Mac.

Pages has no framework a separate process can use, so this server drives Pages itself through Apple events — the same route apple-notes-mcp takes for Notes. Pages must be running, and the grant appears under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation. The app may show as "Pages Creator Studio" there and in permission dialogs; that is a display-name change Apple made, not a different app.

Pages has no library the way Notes has folders — it only knows about documents open right now. documents_list shows what is open; open_document opens a file that is not.

update_document makes you say whether you are appending or replacing. Silently replacing a whole document's body is the mistake worth designing against.

Password-protected documents are refused by every tool that would read, write or export one, and no tool accepts a password as an argument — the same policy apple-pdf-mcp uses for encrypted PDFs.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple Inc.

tools.name: pages_status
tools.description: Reports whether Pages is running, whether this server may automate it, and what limits are in force. Touches no document.

tools.name: documents_list
tools.description: Lists every document currently open in Pages, with its page count and whether it has unsaved changes.

tools.name: document_get
tools.description: Returns one open document's body text, page/section/table/image/chart counts, and whether it is password protected.

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Creates a new, unsaved document in Pages — optionally from a named template, optionally with an initial plain-text body.

tools.name: open_document
tools.description: Opens the Pages document at 'path'. Returns the same detail document_get would.

tools.name: update_document
tools.description: Changes an open document's body text. 'mode' is REQUIRED and decides whether text is appended or the whole body is replaced.

tools.name: save_document
tools.description: Saves an open document, to its existing path or to a new one. Requires confirm=true when the destination already exists.

tools.name: close_document
tools.description: Closes an open document. Defaults to discarding unsaved changes; saving requires confirm=true.

tools.name: export_document
tools.description: Exports an open document to pdf, word, epub, rtf, plain_text or pages09. Requires confirm=true when the destination already exists.
